decision_context: Vehicle owner/operator deciding what to do with a suspected DPF/FAP problem
business_hypothesis: The primary lead needs diagnosis and a feasible cleaning/removal route rather than a generic contact form
business_evidence: Owner context and current form/CRM model
trigger: warning light power loss failed regeneration or workshop advice
task_or_job: Determine whether cleaning is applicable obtain the next step and understand who removes/transports the filter
anxieties_or_barriers: Uncertain cause price downtime result and responsibility
decision_criteria: Eligibility next step price drivers timing and responsibility
alternatives: Workshop diagnosis; another cleaner; replacement; postpone or no service
falsification_condition: A representative CRM/call sample shows another task or buyer context dominates qualified and paid work
recommendation: Use as a research and service-blueprint hypothesis only
prohibited_uses: Do not use as approved ad targeting or publish unsupported urgency/results

decision_context: Workshop or service partner coordinating a removed/installed filter
business_hypothesis: Partner workshops may remove/install filters while DPFLAB performs cleaning and the customer may pay the partner directly
business_evidence: Owner context and implemented partner fields
trigger: Workshop identifies a filter requiring off-vehicle cleaning
task_or_job: Coordinate acceptance diagnostics cleaning return and payment responsibility
anxieties_or_barriers: Handoff timing eligibility communication and who invoices which service
decision_criteria: Eligibility handoff time responsibility and price separation
alternatives: In-house solution; another cleaner; replacement; no service
falsification_condition: Partner and CRM evidence shows this route is rare or materially different from the implemented workflow
recommendation: Validate as a separate operational scenario before giving it a dedicated page
prohibited_uses: Do not state partner coverage names SLA or prices without evidence

business_hypothesis: English reduces language friction and may capture residents or businesses who do not use Russian or Estonian
trigger: English-language search ad referral or direct visit
task_or_job: Understand eligibility process price drivers and contact DPFLAB
anxieties_or_barriers: Translation trust response language and operational support
decision_criteria: Comprehension response language and operational follow-up
alternatives: Use Estonian or Russian; another provider; workshop intermediary
falsification_condition: Search/ad/CRM language evidence shows negligible qualified English demand or operations cannot support English follow-up
recommendation: Keep EN technically available while treating acquisition value as unproven
prohibited_uses: Do not claim English demand market size or guaranteed English support
